icsnew.title: Create new calendar link?
icsnew.amount: Every calendar using the old link

icsrevoke.title: Withdraw calendar link?
icsrevoke.after: Those calendars stop getting trips. You can create a new link at any time.

shareend.title: Stop sharing?
shareend.after: They stay as your copy; changes no longer arrive.
shareend.amount: All trips you share with this person

connectionend.title: End this connection?
connectionend.amount: The statistics, leaderboard, open trip offers and plans this person sees of you
connectionend.after: What the person has seen of you so far ends immediately. Trips already shared keep their linked copies.

merge.title: Merge {{from}} into {{to}}?
merge.after: They will name {{to}}. This can't be undone.

companiondel.title: Delete {{name}}?
companiondel.after: The person disappears from all suggestions.

linksoff.title: Turn off public links?
linksoff.after: I delete them at once. Turning on again won't bring them back.

replace.title: Replace contents?
replace.amount: {{missing}} entries are missing from the file and will be deleted. {{kept}} come from {{file}}.
replace.after: These sheets will only hold what the file contains. I take a backup of the whole server first.

carddelete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
carddelete.after: The card and its links to airlines, chains or hotels are gone. Your flights, stays and journeys stay.

rpid.title: Change passkey domain?
rpid.after: None will work; each must be created again.

userdel.title: Delete {{name}}?
userdel.affects: The account {{name}} with all entries and files
userdel.after: It can only be restored from a backup.

userlock.title: Lock {{name}}?
userlock.after: They can't sign in. Their data stays.

user2fa.title: Reset second step?
user2fa.after: They sign in with password only until they set it up again.

invrevoke.title: Revoke invitation?
invrevoke.after: The link stops working at once.

restore.title: Restore backup?
restore.after: Everything changed since is gone. I'll back up the current state first.

restorekey.title: Re-enter the services’ credentials?
restorekey.amount: Every stored key and password of the services
restorekey.after: The backup uses a different key; I can't decrypt these credentials and you enter them again afterwards. Or put the original key (ENCRYPTION_KEY) back and try once more.

bakdel.title: Delete backup?
bakdel.after: I delete the WebDAV copy too if “Also clean up on WebDAV” is on.

logclean.title: Delete old logs?
logclean.after: They can no longer be viewed.

logdel.title: Delete log file?
logdel.after: It can no longer be viewed.

reseed.title: Re-read catalogues?
reseed.amount: All shipped entries; your own stay
reseed.after: Shipped entries are up to date. Works three times an hour.

demodel.title: Delete demo account?
demodel.after: No one can sign in as demo any more.

userpw.title: Set a new password?
userpw.after: The old password stops working. I show you the new one once.

fedkey.title: Renew the server key?
fedkey.after: They are cut off until each one confirms the new key.

peerremove.title: Stop trusting this server?
peerremove.after: Nothing comes from there any more, and nothing goes there.

mine.h: If your admin switched the service off, it stays off.

ollremote.s: Then each account agrees on its own
